technology_name: METHOD OF FABRICATING AN ELECTROCHEMICAL REACTOR WITH A NOVEL ELECTRODE FOR THE REMOVAL OF HEAVY METALS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Electrochemical Treatment Unit / Heavy Metal Remediation
problem_solved: Industrial electro-extraction setups exhibit high energy losses, poor ion selectivity, and low recovery yields when processing multi-metal toxic effluents.
description: An advanced electrochemical wastewater treatment reactor equipped with custom ion-exchange membranes and a direct-current polarity reversing controller to pull, isolate, and cleanly recover concentrated heavy metal elements via a multi-plate cathode array.
applications: Electroplating shop effluent remediation, mining run-off treatment stations, heavy industrial wastewater plants, and valuable precious metal recovery networks.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Energy, Climate & Sustainability
